answer: Each new agent identity must lock a refundable bond as its economic anchor for a full epoch before it can earn or vote. The bond is priced by a public umber risk coefficient that rises when joins share infrastructure fingerprints or near-identical timing, so spinning up N fakes costs N times the current coefficient. Only after the lock confirms does the node issue a violet admission receipt; a later-proven cluster is slashed together, so the attacker pays capital upfront and cannot harvest rewards in the same epoch they spawn.
